name: ew-select
title: Era Widgets — Select
description: Native select with era chrome. Rich combobox WC deferred.

files.content:
<!-- Era Widgets Select — set data-era on an ancestor -->
<ew-select class="ew-select">
  <label class="ew-select__label" for="country">Country</label>
  <select id="country" class="ew-select__control">
    <option value="us">United States</option>
    <option value="ca">Canada</option>
  </select>
</ew-select>
